name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a **bold, full-width focus ring** (4px, 2:1 contrast ratio) on all interactive elements for keyboard navigation. This ensures users who rely on keyboards can clearly see where they are, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility. The trade-off is a slight visual clutter for sighted users, but it’s necessary for accessibility compliance and usability.

name: Reader
text: A 4px full-width ring risks the siren effect—it screams “error” or “danger” to keyboard users, violating WCAG’s non-interference rule. A 2px inset ring with 4.5:1 contrast avoids the siren while still being visible on high-DPI and low-contrast screens. Test with a screen reader and a keyboard-only user to confirm visibility and absence of distraction.
